Maya: Heads-up — FinBank's POC hit an error when trying to spin up a Dedicated GPU pool in eu-west4. Customer sees 'pool provisioning failed'. Can infra triage?
Liam: Can you paste the error or screenshot and the POC id? I can loop in CSM.
Maya: POC id fb-poc-2026. Error they pasted: `error: GPU pool creation failed: insufficient quota in eu-west4 for sku a100-80gb (code: ProvisionError)`
Priya: That error usually means either quota for that GPU SKU in the region is zero or the account's reservation is set for a different region. Can you run `rictl quotas inspect --region eu-west4 --sku a100-80gb` and `rictl reservations list --account fb-poc-2026`?
Maya: Ran the first one, output: `eu-west4 a100-80gb quota=0 used=0`. Reservations list shows `rsv-1234 region=eu-west1 gpu_sku=a100-80gb capacity=4`.
Priya: There's the mismatch — reservation is in eu-west1 but the POC is requesting eu-west4. Backend rejects create because reserved capacity doesn't cover the requested region, and on-host quotas for A100 in eu-west4 are 0.
Tomas: Confirming: service returns 409/ProvisionError when reservation.region != requested.region. We also log a backend msg: `ReservationRegionMismatch rsv-1234 -> requested eu-west4` in infra-prod.
Maya: Ok — what's the path forward? Customer prefers eu-west for latency, but can move to eu-west1 if needed. Any ETA to get A100 in eu-west4?
Priya: Two options: 1) Quick workaround — create the pool in eu-west1 (matches reservation) which is immediate. 2) Open a quota request for A100 in eu-west4 (takes 24-48h to approve). 3) Use a different GPU SKU available in eu-west4 (e.g., t4 or v100) — cheaper but lower perf.
Maya: If we pick T4 to unblock them, any perf tradeoffs I should warn them about?
Priya: T4 is fine for shorter context models and smaller batch sizes; for long-context LLMs A100 will be better. If they accept T4 we can spin up a temporary pool now and run a perf smoke test.
Liam: Also FYI — customer asked about pricing impact if we change GPU sku — can we get a ballpark?
Priya: Rough numbers: A100 ~3-4x cost vs T4 for token throughput. I'll DM finance for exact rate card for this POC.
deploy-bot: Support ticket created: SUP-5982 — "Quota request / reservation mismatch for fb-poc-2026" (https://support.redwood/sup/5982)
Maya: Thx. I'll present options to FinBank and ask if they can accept eu-west1 or T4 temp. Any chance we can move reservation rsv-1234 to eu-west4?
Priya: We can change reservation region but that requires coordination (billing + capacity) and may be blocked if we don't actually have A100 quota in eu-west4. Command (internal-only): `rictl reservations update --id rsv-1234 --region eu-west4` — but don't run until quota confirmed. Better: request quota first, then update reservation or create a new reservation scoped to eu-west4.
Tomas: FYI, if they need immediate handover to Dedicated in eu-west4, we can also provision dedicated with a different reservation id if sales approves a new commit. Otherwise eu-west1 pool is fastest.
Liam: Also, customer asked about security: do Dedicated pools support private VPC and SOC2?
Priya: Yes — Dedicated supports customer VPC peering and we are SOC2 compliant. For Private deploys we do additional network controls.
Maya: I'll share the options with the customer. Marking action items: Priya to open quota request + confirm rate card, Tomas to note backend logs, Liam to confirm on security note. Will update once FinBank chooses. :thumbsup:
support-bot: Ticket SUP-5982 updated: quota request submitted, ETA 24-48h.
